title: 5.11.2 Sub-build: Spawn and recycle
description: A pipe comes from the right, crosses, and is gone. Then two, then many, and none of them pile up.

steps.title: Run it first
steps.instructions: One pipe sits on the right and never moves. Nothing spawns and nothing is cleaned up.

steps.title: Spawn on a timer
steps.instructions: Every 90 frames, make a pipe at the right edge with a negative `vel.x`, and push it into an array. `every(90, () => { ... })` runs the function every 90 frames.
hints: Make the timer once, in `setup()`, never inside `draw()`.
A pipe made every frame is 60 pipes a second.

steps.title: Recycle what leaves
steps.instructions: In `draw()`, loop from the end of the array: when a pipe is off the left edge, `delete()` it and `splice(i, 1)` it out of the array. Both, not one.
hints: A deleted sprite stays in the array with `.removed` true until you splice it.
Loop backwards: splicing moves every later pipe down one place.

requirements.title: Made on a timer
requirements.description: A timer (every/after, or frameCount %) creates pipes, not draw() every frame. Help: 5.2.2 (Reading: Random numbers and timers)

requirements.title: Gone from screen and list
requirements.description: An off-screen pipe is deleted and spliced out of the array. Help: 5.11.1 (Reading: A world that scrolls)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a short moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: Spawn and recycle". The task: create pipes on a timer (every or after), push each into an array with a negative vel.x, and remove off-screen pipes from both the screen (delete) and the array (splice), looping backwards. This is a sub-build: a small isolated program whose only job is this one mechanic. Accept any names, helpers, arrow functions and ternaries. A line only in a comment or string does not count. Use short, plain notes for a 14-year-old, name their own line when something is missing, never write corrected code.

rubric.title: Spawned by a timer
rubric.description: Pipes are made by every()/after() or a frameCount beat, set up once, not inside draw() unconditionally.

rubric.title: They move
rubric.description: Each pipe gets a negative vel.x (or x is decreased every frame).
